question: A work can be finished by 8 men in 10 days working 6 hours a day or same can be finished by 20 qualified workers in 6 days working 8 hours a day. 2 men and 4 qualified workers work simultaneously 10 hours a day, the work will be finished in ________ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A work can be finished by 8 men in 10 days working 6 hours a day or same can be finished by 20 qualified workers in 6 days working 8 hours a day.

2 men and 4 qualified workers work simultaneously 10 hours a day.

**Formula used:**

Work done = Number of workers × Number of days × Number of hours per day

**Calculation:**

Work done by 8 men in 10 days working 6 hours/day:

⇒ 8 × 10 × 6 = 480 man-hours
